4823-5612-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
4823-5612-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Kudo, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Timeless Witness token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

104-3490-5231-8319.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-5231-8319.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Greenhouse Propagator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

4279-5075-6559--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5075-6559--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger, Ogre Slumlord and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

132-549-4687-7013.easyPrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
132-549-4687-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
132-549-4687-7013.description:
Activate Myr Welder using White Lotus Tile's ability by tapping it, adding at least {2}{G/U}.
Activate Myr Welder using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, targeting any permanent.
Repeat.
132-549-4687-7013.notes: This combo only produces infinite mana if you control at least four creatures that share a creature type.

1479-2692-2841-8101.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Wooded Foothills.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2692-2841-8101.description:
Fetch a land using Wooded Foothills.
When the fetched land enters, Felidar Retreat and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Felidar Retreat triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1236-2018-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Rattleblaze Scarecrow.
When Rattleblaze Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers if it didn't have a -1/-1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Rattleblaze Scarecrow didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist trigger, if applicable, returning Rattleblaze Scarecrow from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Rattleblaze Scarecrow from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if Rattleblaze Scarecrow is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1236-2018-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

553-819-4838.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Najal.
In response, cast Memory Lapse by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

5256-7096--5.easyPrerequisites: You've had at least one land enter this turn.
5256-7096--5.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat

2079-2440-6737-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Barret's triggers, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token.
When the Rebel enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Rebel you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Rebel token.
Activate the Rebel by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2079-2440-6737-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Rebel.

1069-1169-1256-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1169-1256-5499.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

4050-5170-6132-7286.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

5640-5917-7220.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {1}.
5640-5917-7220.description:
Activate a mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting the mana-producing creature.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying The Jolly Balloon Man's ability, targeting Glamermite.
Resolve the copy of The Jolly Balloon Man's ability, creating a token copy of Glamermite that is a 1/1 Balloon with haste.
When Glamermite enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping The Jolly Balloon Man.
Resolve the Jolly Ballon Man ability from step 2, creating a token copy of the mana-producing creature that is a 1/1 Balloon with haste.
Activate the mana-producing creature token by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-3918-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
1978-3918-7013.description:
Activate Trazyn using White Lotus Tile's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct or activate Trazyn using Voltaic Construct's ability by paying {2}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.

147-413-3047.description:
Cast Feign Death by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Feign Death, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Feign Death.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, Feign Death triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Blasting Station abilities from step 5.

122-328-2732-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant.
When Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant die, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers twice, exiling Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant from your graveyard.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant from exile to the battlefield.
When Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Gray Merchant trigger, causing each opponent to lose an amount of life equal to your devotion to black, and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Resolve the Phyrexian Delver trigger, causing you to return Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield and lose 4 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from steps 1 and 3.
Repeat.

2034-2267-5496-6718.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Extractor Demon triggers, causing you to mill two cards if your graveyard is empty, or causing an opponent to mill two cards otherwise.
If your library is empty, activate Tomb Trawler by paying {2}, putting a card from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Tormod triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.
2034-2267-5496-6718.notes: The combo will grant you an amount of {C} equal to the number of cards in your library, as you do not need to do step 3 as long as your library has cards in it. You can instead also target an opponent in step 2 if your graveyard is not empty.

2043-4659-6441-6671.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Magic Pot that are 1/1 Soldiers.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Magic Pot tokens die, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

729-2440-3263-4183.notablePrerequisites: Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
729-2440-3263-4183.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Great Oak Guardian with haste.
When the token Great Oak Guardian enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Great Oak Guardian trigger, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Great Oak Guardian.
Repeat.

3322-4826-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
3322-4826-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
3322-4826-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to Archelos.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nikya of the Old Ways triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-4050-5551.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
1270-4050-5551.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Taq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Lazotep Convert, adding one mana of any color.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Taq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

647-3259-5500.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-3259-5500.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Seraphic Steed as attackers.
Seraphic Steed triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1799-2034-2048-3862.notablePrerequisites: You do not control an Army.
1799-2034-2048-3862.description:
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Orcish Bowmasters on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Orcish Bowmasters into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Orcish Bowmasters enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target, then creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Army and Orcish Bowmasters, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

262-2773-3332.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Deep-Slumber Titan.
Deep-Slumber Titan does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to give Deep-Slumber Titan indestructible.
262-2773-3332.description:
Give Deep-Slumber Titan indestructible, if needed.
Activate Deep-Slumber Titan by tapping it, creating seven 1/1 Elemental creature tokens.
When the Elementals enter the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Warstorm Surge trigger, dealing 1 damage to Deep-Slumber Titan.
Deep-Slumber Titan triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve all remaining Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing 6 damage divided among any number of targets.
Repeat from step 2.

2838-2979-4762.notablePrerequisites: Patchwork Crawler does not have summoning sickness, and does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2838-2979-4762.description:
Activate Patchwork Crawler using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Patchwork Crawler using Soul Diviner's ability by tapping it and removing a -1/-1 counter from it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

803-1789-2232-2459.notablePrerequisites:
"Dragon" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
You have enough mana to pay for commnader tax, if applicable.
803-1789-2232-2459.description:
Cast Rograkh either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {0} plus commnander tax, if applicable.
When Rograkh enters the battlefield, Lathliss and Cloudstone Curio triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Rograkh from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4067-4131-5074.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Tower of Fortunes by paying {8} and tapping it, causing you to draw four cards.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Tower of Fortunes.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Basalt Monolith.
Activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 4 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

479-1561-2647-3365.notablePrerequisites:
Final Fortune in hand.You have at least twenty-six cards in library.
You have at least 2 life.
479-1561-2647-3365.description:
Cast Peer into the Abyss, drawing at least twelve cards and losing half your life total.
Cast Warrior's Oath, gaining an extra turn.
Activate Aeromeba by discarding a card to switch Aeromeba's power and toughness until end of turn.
Repeat step 3 until you have exactly thirteen cards in your hand.
Pass to the extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Triskaidekaphile triggers, winning the game.

1636-3590-3780.notablePrerequisites:
Samite Blessing attached to Warchanter Skald.
Warchanter Skald does not have summoning sickness.
1636-3590-3780.description:
Activate Warchanter Skald using the Samite Blessing ability by tapping it, targeting any creature.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker token.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2372-2914-4992.description:
Stormtide makes everything an island, choke prevents them from untapping.
Wilderness Reclamation untaps your lands.

3525-5089-5116.notablePrerequisites: Gilded Lotus does not have summoning sickness.
3525-5089-5116.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability, causing Gilded Lotus to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying {1}{U}{U}, enchanting Gilded Lotus.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.
